name: Golden Ball

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 16% ATK damage to all enemies in a 5-hit combo, with a 100% chance to inflict [Collapse] on 2 random targets for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 16% ATK damage to all enemies in a 5-hit combo, with a 100% chance to inflict [Collapse] on 3 random targets for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self HP. After each action, if there is an enemy in [Collapse], deals additional damage equal to 10% ATK to the target just attacked, and each additional enemy in [Collapse] deals a further 10% ATK of additional damage.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self HP. After each action, if there is an enemy in [Collapse], deals additional damage equal to 15% ATK to the target just attacked, and each additional enemy in [Collapse] deals a further 15% ATK of additional damage.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants self HP. After each action, if there is an enemy in [Collapse], deals additional damage equal to 17% ATK to the target just attacked, and each additional enemy in [Collapse] deals a further 17% ATK of additional damage.

bondList: Lily of the Three Section Staff + Eyelashes + Smile Man
